rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Labour Law art. 3 excludes domestic workers; dedicated Law 15/2017 and the Standard Unified Contract.
rules.s: Law 14/2004 art. 3; Law 15/2017; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Written contract on the Standard Unified Contract, authenticated by the ministry, bilingual (Arabic and another language).

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: National minimum wage (QAR 1,000 a month) applies to domestic workers, plus QAR 500 housing and QAR 300 food if not provided.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Paid at the end of the month and no later than the third day of the next, by bank account or in cash against a signed receipt; recruitment costs may not be deducted.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Law sets a 10-hour daily cap excluding breaks; the standard contract sets 8 normal hours plus up to 2 hours' overtime at 125 per cent.
rules.s: Law 15/2017 art. 12; Standard Unified Contract art. 4; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Three weeks' paid annual leave a year, and a return air ticket home every two years.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi
rules.n: Confiscating passports is an offence (fine up to QAR 25,000), but the employer may keep the passport with the worker's written consent.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Suitable accommodation and food; no specific occupational safety or accommodation standard for domestic workers.

rules.v: Worker may change employer without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh pindah tanpa persetujuan pemberi kerja
rules.n: Change of employer at any time without the employer's permission, with one or two months' notice through the ministry system (compensation capped at two months' wage during probation); no exit permit, 72 hours' notice before leaving the country.
rules.s: Law 21/2015 and Executive Regulations arts 7, 65; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: The standard contract places recruitment fees on the agency or employer and bars deductions from the worker.
rules.s: Law 15/2017; Standard Unified Contract; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
rules.n: Licensed offices; liability for return in the probation period.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Complaint-based, including the online Unified Platform for Complaints and Whistleblowers.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Ministry conciliation, then the Labour Dispute Settlement Committee (decision within three weeks, appeal to the Appellate Court, no court fees); unpaid awards via the Workers' Support and Insurance Fund.
rules.s: Law 13/2017; Cabinet Decision 6/2018; Law 17/2018; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Employer-paid medical care for sickness or injury; up to two weeks' paid sick leave after three months; end-of-service gratuity of three weeks' pay a year; maternity not specified.
rules.s: Law 15/2017 art. 15; Standard Unified Contract; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
rules.n: Two government shelters for trafficking victims; complaints to the National Committee to Combat Human Trafficking.

rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: Worker committees are open to Qatari workers only; joint committees exist at enterprises with 30 or more workers, which does not fit household employment.
rules.s: Law 14/2004 art. 116, ch. 13; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

decisions.nm: Article 26 complaint concerning Qatar (Forced Labour and Labour Inspection Conventions)
decisions.pe: Worker delegates at the ILO filed a complaint in 2014 about migrant workers in Qatar. In 2017 the ILO closed it when Qatar agreed a programme of labour reforms with the ILO.
decisions.pi: Delegasi pekerja di ILO mengajukan pengaduan pada 2014 tentang pekerja migran di Qatar. Pada 2017 ILO menutupnya ketika Qatar menyepakati program reformasi ketenagakerjaan dengan ILO.

decisions.ct: Labour Dispute Settlement Committee, Qatar (as reported)
decisions.pe: Workers of a construction company in Qatar were not paid for months. About 100 who stayed won their cases at the new labour committees, but reports say the money had not been paid months later.
decisions.pi: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan konstruksi di Qatar tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Sekitar 100 orang yang bertahan memenangkan perkara di komite perburuhan yang baru, tetapi menurut laporan uangnya belum dibayar berbulan-bulan kemudian.

help.de: Workers can file complaints online with their Qatar ID or visa number; disputes go to the Labour Dispute Settlement Committees. Check the Ministry's website for the current hotline.
help.di: Pekerja bisa mengajukan pengaduan secara daring dengan nomor Qatar ID atau visa; perselisihan dibawa ke Komite Penyelesaian Perselisihan Perburuhan. Periksa situs Kementerian untuk nomor bantuan terbaru.
